'''''Seakyte''''' was a group of 6 [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|escort shuttles]] used by the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]], during the final stage of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Sepan campaign|campaign]] to end the [[Sepan Civil War]]. They were launched by the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] ''[[Shemsher]]'' to attack the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']]. They were unsuccessful and were likely all destroyed in the battle.
